ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: New work, Engagement letter out and later stages need Engagement letter status and Conflict check result.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "New_work", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Qualified", 2, "Conflict check", 3, "Proposal", 4, "Proposal sent", 5, "Terms agreed", 6, "Engagement letter out", 7, "Closed won", 8, 0) >= 7, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Engagement_letter_status__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Conflict_check_result__c))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Engagement letter status and Conflict check result before moving to Engagement letter out.
